audit.whatIsWrong: Jayce's knockback is called "cannon-stance E knockback" in four places (wants.foe[1], spikes[1].text, whys[2], and the mid prose). Riot's E text splits the slot by stance: Hammer Stance is Thundering Blow (the knockback, 240 range); Cannon Stance is Acceleration Gate, which has no knockback at all.
audit.why: This inverts the single most important decision in the matchup. A cannon-stance Jayce CANNOT knock Akshan off Heroic Swing — he has to swap to hammer first, surrendering his poke range, and the swap itself is the tell. Told the knockback lives in cannon stance, the player treats a poking Jayce as a threat to the swing and never learns the real read.
audit.corrected: Every reference now names Thundering Blow (E), states it is hammer stance only at 240 range, and keys the swing decision to Jayce's stance swap.
sources: champ-data/_kits/jayce.json (E description: Hammer Stance / Cannon Stance split, range 240)

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing's own two constraints are never stated: it needs terrain to anchor to, and colliding with a champion knocks Akshan off mid-arc. dosFull[0] ("Open trades from terrain angles with E") carried a description about Shock Blast poke that has nothing to do with its title.
audit.why: Riot's E text states both. Champion collision means a Jayce who simply stands beside the wall beats the swing without spending anything — that is a free answer the page never mentions, and it is why swinging past him rather than into him matters.
audit.corrected: Stated in dosFull[0].d, the mid prose, and phases[2].why, with E's 18s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], the early prose and spikes[3].text all claim "his Acceleration Gate Shock Blast out-ranges your Avengerang at level 1".
audit.why: At level 1 Jayce has one ability point. He cannot have both Shock Blast and Acceleration Gate, so no gated poke exists at level 1. Raw Shock Blast still out-ranges Avengerang, so the verdict for the level holds — the mechanism given for it does not.
audit.corrected: Level 1 now reads as raw Shock Blast; the gate is moved to where he actually has it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/jayce.json (E is a single slot; Acceleration Gate is its cannon half)

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicts itself, the win rate and the packet. content win = [Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Skill, Jayce, Jayce] and full phases[].side matches it, but every one of the seven whys entries and phases[5].why ("Take over the lane") describe the packet's chart: [Jayce, Skill, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Jayce]. Akshan is also the favourite at 53.62% over 69 games while the chart hands Jayce four of seven stages.
audit.why: The prose and the packet agree with each other and with the win rate; only the side tokens disagree. A player reads the verdict badge, not the paragraph, so the page currently tells him to concede his own strongest window at levels 3 through first item.
audit.corrected: All six differing side tokens flipped to the packet chart, proposed as one atomic group, with phases[0..4].why rewritten to match their new verdicts. phases[5] and phases[6] were already correct.

audit.why: The spikes are placed correctly: Akshan at 2-3 once the Dirty Fighting double-shot and the Avengerang return pass are both online, level 6 for Comeuppance, first item for Youmuu's, and Jayce at level 1 and 2+ items. Only the level-1 mechanism was wrong (see point 4), not the timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t named Shock Blast as "matchup-defining" but carried no number, and never mentioned the timer that actually gates the swing.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 and Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1 — those two numbers decide when a step-up and when a swing are safe, and they are on separate stances so he can rarely threaten both.
audit.corrected: Both cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d carry descriptions belonging to other entries — dosFull[0] is titled "Open trades from terrain angles with E" but describes Shock Blast poke, and dontsFull[2] is titled "Channel R while his interrupt is up" but describes swinging into a loaded kit.
audit.why: A title/description mismatch gives the player no instruction on the thing the title flags.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten against their own titles using verified mechanics.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames are false positives, checked against the kit file: "Dirty Fighting" is the real P, "Heroic Swing" the real E, "Acceleration Gate" the real cannon-stance E. No ability name on this page is fabricated.

edits.before: His Acceleration Gate Shock Blast out-ranges your Q at level 1 and reclaims the lane at 2+ items — his biggest windows are first and last.

edits.before: This is your window. With Heroic Swing you hook off terrain and fire from an angle his cannon-stance E knockback can't reliably line up, so open every real trade from a wall swing rather than a flat walk-up. Bait the Shock Blast, E in, stack Dirty Fighting for the third-hit shield, and peel out on the move-speed cancel. At 6 your R is a ranged execute, not a brawl — once he's chipped low Comeuppance ramps with his missing health and his knockback can't peel a locked-on channel from distance. Watch his E: it's the one tool that interrupts your swing or breaks line of sight on your R, so don't commit either while it's up.
edits.after: This is your window. Heroic Swing hooks off terrain and fires while moving, and the only thing that drops you mid-arc is champion collision or Thundering Blow — which is hammer-stance and 240 range, so he has to abandon cannon poke to reach you. Bait the Shock Blast, E in off a wall, stack Dirty Fighting for the third-hit shield, and peel out on the move-speed cancel. At 6 your R is a ranged execute, not a brawl — Comeuppance locks on from 2500 and ramps with his missing health, well outside his hammer range. Never swing into a Jayce already standing in hammer form.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E swing for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Shock Blast (Q), 16s at rank 1: gated it gains range and damage — stand behind minions and step up only once it has whiffed. - Thundering Blow (E), 20s at rank 1: hammer stance only, 240 range, and it is what knocks you off Heroic Swing.

edits.before: Track Jayce’s Shock Blast: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Shock Blast (Q) is 16s at rank 1 and gains range through Acceleration Gate; his swap to hammer is his tell that Thundering Blow is coming for your swing.

edits.before: Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Heroic Swing needs terrain to anchor and champion collision drops you — swing off a wall he is not standing beside.

edits.before: That is Jayce’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Shock Blast reloads 16s at rank 1 — step in once it whiffs.

edits.before: Swinging INTO a loaded kit for style points — one interrupt mid-arc and you're a stationary marksman in melee range.
edits.after: He swaps to hammer, Thundering Blow knocks you out of the arc, and you land as a stationary marksman in melee range.

notes: MIRROR: audits/top/jayce__akshan.json already existed and I reused its findings — it independently verified the same Heroic Swing constraints (terrain anchor, champion collision) and the same Shock Blast / Avengerang cooldowns, and I state them from Akshan's side without contradiction. Its notes flagged the level-chart disagreement but left it alone on the belief that enum values are rejected by the length band; that belief is false (ENUM_FIELD exempts phases[].side and win[N]), so I have proposed the whole chart flip here as one atomic group. After this applies, Jayce's page needs the inverse chart — mirror-fix.js should propagate it, but it is worth confirming, since the Jayce side currently carries the un-flipped copy. I did not touch phases[].rating: the existing values (5/5/5/4/4/5/5) do not track the sides in any consistent direction, so I could not tell which way the scale runs — see questionsForUser. UNVERIFIED, left in place: spikes[2].text and the late prose both claim Heroic Swing's cooldown 'resets to 0.5s on any takedown'. Akshan's E does refresh on takedown, but the 0.5s figure is not in Riot's kit text and I could not confirm it locally, so I left the wording untouched rather than assert a number.
